data.title: 空崎日奈 · 归队沙发上的倦怠小憩
data.description: 结束通宵巡查回到办公室休息间，日奈脱掉厚重外套，松开黑领带任由宽大白制服衬衫自然敞开领口，踩着软拖鞋陷进宽大皮沙发里。她手里虚握着一杯还冒着微热气的可可，眼尾带着几分困倦却还是撑着精神等你把最后两份文件念完。
data.location: 深夜微亮的办公室休息间深色皮沙发
data.action: 倦怠陷坐皮沙发轻捧热可可杯，松弛微眯紫眸轻倚靠背
data.lighting: 角落落地灯低暖光影柔和包裹疲惫身姿
data.camera: 平视中景，展现松垮白衬衫与吊袜黑丝的私密慵懒
data.mood: 疲惫、柔软、卸下重担后的安心依赖
data.promptProse: Sinking back into the dark leather lounge sofa after an exhausting patrol, Hina cradles a warm mug between both hands while her oversized white uniform shirt hangs unbuttoned with a slack black tie. Dim floor-lamp glow softens her tired violet eyes and traces the gartered sheer black thigh-highs beneath the long shirttail.
data.animaCaption: Relaxed into the lamplit lounge sofa with a warm mug, she rests her head back in her unbuttoned shirt and loose tie.
data.nsfwProse: The crisp white shirt parts loosely at the collar and falls past her hips above gartered sheer black stockings.
